actions.description: Switch the laser emission on (the native enable)
actions.name: enable_emission

outputs.description: True once the laser reports that emission is on
outputs.name: is_on

actions.description: Switch the laser emission off (the native disable, the safe state); it takes no input
actions.name: disable_emission

outputs.description: False once the laser reports that emission is off
outputs.name: is_on

adjusts.description: Power set point as a fraction of the head's maximum power; the native call writes it as a watt value of the head's maximum power
adjusts.name: power

facts.text: The laser is opened on a serial line at 115200 baud, 8N1 with a 0.1 s timeout; the constructor queries the serial number (sn?), disables autostart (@cobas 0) and reads the head's maximum power in mW (gmlp?)
initialize() disables direct control (@cobasdr 0) and forces autostart on (@cob1)
Emission is turned on with the l1 command after get_is_on() confirms it, and get_is_on() reads l? and returns True when the reply is b'1'
The native disable sends the l0 command and returns its reply; it does not clear the Device.enabled flag that enable() sets
get_status sends l?, p?, pa?, f? and hrs? and returns each reply as a status line

A power fraction is converted to mW of the head's maximum power and written as '@cobasp <watts>' with four decimals; the comment states that there is no minimum power and any non-negative number is accepted
The LightSource power property is in the [0, 1] interval, and its setter clips the argument to that interval before reaching _do_set_power

OnlyTriggersBulbOnSoftwareMixin fixes trigger_type to SOFTWARE and trigger_mode to BULB, and its _do_trigger raises IncompatibleStateError ('trigger does not make sense in trigger mode bulb, only enable')

measures.description: True while the laser reports that emission is on (the l? query)
measures.name: is_on

measures.description: True while the device object is enabled (the Device.enabled flag enable() sets)
measures.name: enabled

measures.description: Measured output power as a fraction of the head's maximum power (0 while emission is off)
measures.name: measured_power

measures.description: Status lines the laser reports: emission on, target power, measured power, fault and head operating hours
measures.name: status
